content:
A listener writes “Hello Wes, I finally decided to send you an email about a possible siding I had which probably was around 25 years ago. I had a small mum business at home . And I was at the field going to do some watering of the ones that were in flower pots I was by myself on the farm just with I had one of my dogs with me. To give you a reference I live off of the main highway about a little over a quarter of a mile on a dead end road surrounded by woods.

So I’m filling water jugs from a tank. Now the end of my mom field is about 75 yards there’s a fence that goes across there and it’s covered in wild honeysuckle vine this was about late September the honeysuckle vine was so thick you could not see through it so half of the fence roll was covered in that. And there’s woods behind that in a Big Creek.

I’m filling up the watering cans so I stand up and I looked straight down and I see something that’s chocolate brown like it’s peeking behind the honeysuckle vine looking at me. And as soon as I look up and catch a glance it gets behind the honeysuckle just like an adult playing peekaboo with a child.

Like I said it was all I seen was chocolate brown I didn’t see any face and it was so quick I thought for a second I thought well that wasn’t a deer dear that’s an odd movement we have a lot of whitetail deer here and I thought that I know that wasn’t no deer.

We don’t have bears here and I kind of thought to myself well maybe that was maybe it was nothing and I was talking myself out of it I go back to doing what I’m doing finally my little dog comes over beside me she’s completely deaf. And she’s standing right beside me looking that direction and so I thought this time I’m going to look as I’m standing up just to see if I see that again and yes I did and my dog seen it this time she goes to barking like crazy so I thought well I know I seen something the first time as well.

She would not run down there I did not smell anything all I know is what I saw and it was the same thing just the chocolate brown no facial feature I could tell it was like hair it looks cuz you know like I said this was probably less this was probably less than 75 yards away from me I think it was just watching me but to continue on with my story. This is before you know all the Bigfoot hunting shows are on TV this is the for cell phones so I knew of Bigfoot I had seen the Patterson film documentary on TBS or whatever I knew of Bigfoot okay I go back to the house and I just kept wondering trying to figure out what that was and I thought I think that was a Bigfoot.

I call my sister and I tell her I said I think there was a Bigfoot watching me of course she laughs hysterically and I said I’m serious I really think that was it was like the shoulders and the movement darting behind there I said I just don’t know what else that could have been. Now to set another reference I live on a hundred acres like I said on a dead end road surrounded by woods no neighbors close by so I told her I said I think I’m going to walk back that Old road bed and act like I pass out or her twisting ankle or something and see if I see it around somewhere watching me. And she was like you better not that it’ll get you and I said if you wanted to get me it had plenty of chances yesterday I was by myself with this little dog nobody would have heard anything you could have got me yesterday I think it was just watching me curious to what I was doing.

Now I want to give you some reference points this Creek that I mentioned this is a pretty big Creek that drains all the way down to the tradewater river which is a small tributary river that drains into the big Ohio River.

And I myself could walk to the tradewater river through the woods which is roughly maybe two miles away maybe and be unseen if I wanted to.

So I don’t know if it was just passing through here I do believe that they migrate in some areas and you know I’ve always seen a lot of things that they travel the rivers stay close to the rivers I don’t know but I do know this 2 years about 2 years after that.

I had mentioned to someone that I know about the story because I just always had that feeling that was a Bigfoot and they said well you know they found tracks in tulu which what does that little area border they allow River and it’s not too far from me it’s in the same county that I’m in. It just so happened the person that I’m not sure who casted the tracks I have not seen them but the person that holds them has them in possession was a preacher that I graduated with his son that preacher has passed on now I’m sure his wife still has them the truck the cast from the tracks. And that would be over some hills and through the woods to that area which this little river that I mentioned the tradewater would drains into there so I don’t think that’s coincidence.

And I know since that time has passed I live under a big hill you know we have these Kentucky hills so I’m in the valley below this big hill up on top of this hill it’s just woods hunting area there’s nobody that lives up there and it’s a pretty good three or 400 acres I think that it passes through here because since that time there’s certain times of the year late fall early winter sometimes we hear would knocks in the middle of the night.

It might last for a week or two and we know it’s not a woodpecker they’re not out at night but and so it’ll echo through here you know through this valley and it sounds like it’s way on top of the hill so I don’t know I think sometimes they pass through here .

And as far as the lights I have never seen lights in these woods but I’ll tell you something I have seen before and I’ve never heard nobody else ever say they have seen this.

Back when I was in high school I think I was 17 I was with four of my friends so there was five of us in a car which was a Ford Maverick 2-door that’s very important.

This main city of my county is a small town there’s nothing for teenagers to do except congregate on parking lots and hang out and talk on the weekend well every now and then they would start running everybody off the place.

So we had this little area that we would go to just to hang out and talk nobody’s doing nothing illegal just to hang out because there was nowhere so me and my two girlfriends we got in the car with our two friends one was driving one was in the passenger the two guys we were going out to this area that we went to to see if any of cuz nobody was in town.

So we get out there and it’s lit up it’s got a security light and it’s a dead end Little road and it’s almost just one car wide Little road it’s about maybe 5 minutes outside of town well there’s nobody there so I remember this it was kind of chilly so this could have been in November late October I’m not sure so anyway we thought well we’ll just sit here and wait maybe somebody else so come out here.

So we were there probably 10 or 15 minutes and I look up and I couldn’t see the road because it’s a hill a bank and some trees but I can see a light and I said oh here comes somebody here’s some headlights.

It’s dark it’s probably 7:00 or 8:00 at night so they said oh yeah here comes somebody so we’re seeing this light get closer and closer just like headlights and when it comes around the last little curve where we can see it it is a ball of fire.

It comes it’s mid-air it’s about 5 ft off the ground and it’s just going at a steady speed and it comes to within the bumper of the car and it’s eye level in the windshield like we’re looking out through the front windshield and it’s just on the other side of the bumper it’s suspended in air about like I said about
four and a half 5 ft and Air.

Perfect sphere of fire!!

All the flames for yellow and there was a little orange in there and they none of the flame extended outside of the Sphere. It hovered it hovered in the air for I’d say between 6 to 10 seconds and we’re all just staring at it it’s really bright and then it just lifts up slowly where it gets above the car and then shoots over the roof we turn and look at the back windshield and it’s gone through the woods.

And I believe it was me who said what the hell was that?

In the driver was like I don’t know but we’re not sticking around to find out and we drove to town and nobody said anything we were all just stunned shocked trying to make sense of what we just seen.

I can still see that in my in my vision I can still see that in my memory it was a perfect Spirit and the spirit self was at least 3 ft wide by 3 ft tall at least it could have been four it was pretty big size lot bigger than a basketball lot bigger than a large pizza I mean it was fairly large. Anyway when we got back to town one said you know we can’t tell anybody about this cuz nobody’s going to believe us and we’re like we don’t we’re not going to talk about it this is got to we got to forget this happened of course we were all I’m going to be honest we were all pretty shaken up and scared about it because like what was this this is a ball of fire what if they had come through the windshield and just blow up the car . Anyway we just never talked about it anymore but about 6 years ago I became reacquainted with the two girls that I had been close friends with and I asked him I said do y’all remember that I said tell me what you remember I want to see if it’s the same thing that I remember. And they both told me the exact same story they remembered it exactly I seen one of the boys in a store about a year after that and I asked him I said Kenneth do you remember that happening and he said yes I said well tell me what you remember I want to see if it’s the same memory I have and he said I won’t talk about that. And I said well why because I know it was real and he said I’m not going to talk about that and he wouldn’t say anything. And the one that was driving I haven’t crossed paths with but when I do I will ask him if he remembers that and what he remembers because I’ve never seen nothing like that since and I’ve never heard anybody say they’ve seen a ball of fire in the mid air just zooming around .

I’ve been listening to your show for quite a while and I know sometimes people will share paranormal experiences I have a well actually I have several but I have two that I would like to tell you about, one is about 20 years ago or 25 years ago anyway I worked at a hospital and I worked in the operating room and I had a very stressful job but it was a small hospital so you’re working with a small group of people and I’m sure you know it only takes one to ruin the attitudes of everyone and there was one in the bunch. And that person just seemed to want to cause a lot of problems for me but so they’re sets that the mood so I’m very stressed all the time and I had taken a day off now this was in October I remember pacifically because it was cool at night cool in the mornings but about the middle of the day it would warm up in the 70s beautiful skies so I decided I was going to go up there and work on cleaning my chicken coop out had a concrete floor at my barn.

Now I could not see the front of my house it was a little distance I don’t know but I had five dogs at this time now that is very important. So I go up there I’m starting to work the dogs they all get settled down and they’re sunbathing laying out the sun perfectly still dog napping and I just have a lot of things on my mind and then all the sudden I hear my name it was a woman’s voice that I did not recognize and she’s sang my name. And I threw down my shovel and I started running towards the house cuz I thought it was somebody had pulled up and was hollering for me and as I take off then my dogs jump up and they’re following behind me they beat me to the house and when I get where I can see there’s nobody there there’s no car there’s nobody.

And I thought well that was odd I know I heard that and as I’m walking back and I’m thinking yeah but the dogs didn’t hear it because they would have jumped up and beat me up there before I ever got the shovel put down so they didn’t hear it so I thought well I guess I’m hearing voices now with all the stress and everything . So but part of me was like I know I heard that I thought I’m going to go back to doing what I was doing and I’m not going to think of anything I’m just going to concentrate on what I’m doing and see if I hear it again so maybe 5 minutes past give or take the dogs get settled down they go back to laying there in the Sun everything’s quiet and I’m listening this time I’m listening for it it happens again same way a woman’s voice that I don’t recognize and she’s sang my name. Well before I put my shovel down I looked out and the dogs were perfectly still so they did not hear that and I thought to myself maybe there’s somebody at the house I’m going to go look so I start walking up there but I knew there wasn’t and then the dogs jump up and here they come running and there’s nobody but the dogs didn’t hear it so I knew then the first time it happened they didn’t hear that one either. And I live far enough off the road you cannot your traffic if there’s a group of motorcycles together you might be able to hear that if there’s two or three semis going down the road you might hear that but it’s such a distance and like I said I have no neighbors. So I didn’t hear nobody’s radio and my name is pretty unique and I have no explanation for that.
I’ve had something like that to happen again which was probably a couple years later but this time it was my husband’s voice and he called woman

Which that was kind of an inside joke we had watched some show and this man would call his wife woman and my husband was doing that to me to pick at me and I went outside with these two little dogs to let them run around it was in the middle of winter it’s been been cold as could be and he was in the recliner and anyway I had been outside maybe 10 or 15 minutes.
And when I went towards the back of the house I heard my husband’s voice holler woman I even said responded back I’m around here and he didn’t answer me so I started going back up around to the front he wasn’t there so I opened the door and I went in and he’s asleep sound asleep in the recliner. And I asked him I said did you just holler for me and he said no and I woke him up to ask him and so I knew it wasn’t him but that was his voice sounded like him and I don’t think that’s happened since that time.

I have seen a little ghost of a boy in my yard in my front yard he looks about I’d say between 4 and 5 years old but here’s the weird thing I’m only seeing him one time standing in front of a tree but he was in the SEPTA tones. Just like if you’re looking through old photographs and it’s in the all the browns like dark brown light brown you know it’s in the browns that’s what he was like he looks solid I couldn’t see through him.
I was on the riding mower and I looked up and he was standing in front of that tree I can tell you exactly what he had on he and I just froze there on the rider mower thinking what ??
And he just was looking at me and you know my eyes are seeing this and my brain is trying to figure out what I’m looking at it doesn’t want to believe that’s what I’m looking at and he was all in that colors all the brown and then he was just gone like that it lasted about it seemed like it lasted a long time but it probably was I don’t know 10 to 15 seconds.

And since that time my son was born and when he was three between three and four I was over in that part of the yard working in a flower bed and he comes over there and he says what are you doing and I said oh I’m just pulling weeds and then we hear this little boy’s voice we both heard it say hello hello hello .

And each time he said hello it would get louder like he was trying to get our attention but we didn’t see anything and my little boy said who was that.

And I said I don’t know maybe it was the wind I was trying I didn’t want him to be scared and we have heard that when you’re over in that part of the yard I have heard it before after that but it’s been a long time since I’ve heard it but you know it would just be hello hello that’s it.

Anyway those are my three biggest paranormal experiences I have had several others but just wanted to share those and tell you my Bigfoot story in my fireball which I think is I don’t know what to think about that one so thank you for your time and thank you for Sasquatch Chronicles.”
